Cancer organizations urge review of prostate cancer testing advice

Cancer organizations are urging a national panel to review outdated testing advice for prostate cancer. This call comes amidst discussions about health updates following diagnoses. The specific advice under review pertains to testing protocols for prostate cancer, with a focus on ensuring current recommendations are up-to-date and effective.
